description: List and search currencies registered on the blockchain. Returns an array of currency definitions with their current state. Supports filtering by launch state, system type, source system, and converter reserves. Without a query object, returns all currencies on the local chain. Use filters when possible — unfiltered queries on mainnet can return very large result sets.

endblock.description: Only return currencies defined at or before this block height.

query.description: Filter object with optional fields: launchstate ("prelaunch"|"launched"|"refund"|"complete"), systemtype ("local"|"imported"|"gateway"|"pbaas"), fromsystem (system name or i-address), converter (string[] of reserve currencies).

startblock.description: Only return currencies defined at or after this block height.

name: listcurrencies
